issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 35,473 (Combined Utilities Fund column)
issues.issue: This is the only receipt of the Combined Utilities Fund and is presumed to be utility charges. Under the user's 2026-10-28 rule, utility fund sales and charges are category Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees. The same applies to detail[12]. The label itself is only 'Other', so the extractor's presumption is still an assumption.
